rule: Month-end s_i = sign(12-month (252-session) cumulative excess return); w_i = s_i*0.40/sigma_i/N (sigma EWMA com 60); book to 10% ex-ante (252d cov), gross<=3; next_close

all_variants.V1: Month-end s_i = sign(12-month (252-session) cumulative excess return); w_i = s_i*0.40/sigma_i/N (sigma EWMA com 60); book to 10% ex-ante (252d cov), gross<=3; next_close
all_variants.V2: As V1 with skip-month 12-1 signal (sessions t-252..t-21)
all_variants.V3: As V1 without vol scaling: w_i = s_i/N equal notional, then book to 10%

selection: headline = highest in-sample net Sharpe (1x) of 3 pre-declared variants
